description: A member write reachable around a back edge publishes a possible member, not an established one: the zero-trip execution is one of the loop's executions, so an unconditional body write is as possible as a conditional one. The publication is the join with what the slot held on the way in, so a slot the loop introduces admits nil while a slot a pre-loop write established keeps its type. A straight-line write past no back edge still establishes its slot exactly.
